mode: retrospective; every historical interval was previously accessible/viewed; no independent holdout claim
development_objective: min(fold annual arithmetic net excess vs matched dynamic equal weight) - 0.25 * max(fold absolute maximum drawdown) - 0.0001 * AST nodes in formula and condition
validation_selection: development gate and validation gate; then descending validation annual arithmetic excess minus 0.25*absolute maximum drawdown minus complexity penalty; id breaks ties
fallback: select no qualified candidate; evaluate a labeled diagnostic leader, not a deployment candidate
stop: three generations only; freeze before validation; select before followup; no post-followup mutation
cost_note: course assumptions: sell tax 5 bps in reused course simulator; not a claim about complete current statutory costs
